Features

BUILT FOR THE MUSIC

Every feature in TrackBack exists because a DJ who cares about their library needed it.

🎚

Configurable Crossfade

Set your crossfade duration and trigger it manually or let it fire automatically at the end of each track. Smooth fade curves, no clicks.

📊

Real-Time Spectrum Analyzer

Per-bar peak hold indicators, zone-coloured gradients (green → yellow → orange → red), and configurable gain. See your music, not just hear it.

🏷

Accurate ID3 Tag Reading

Reads ID3 tags correctly — including Windows-1252 encoding that trips up most players. Typographic characters like em-dashes and curly quotes display as intended, not as garbled symbols.

🖼

Album Art Lookup

Search Discogs and MusicBrainz Cover Art Archive for album artwork and embed it directly into your files. No third-party tools needed.

📁

Library-First Workflow

Point TrackBack at your music folder and it scans and parses your tags automatically. Once loaded, your whole library is browsable and ready to play.

⚡

Lightweight & Native

Built on Tauri (Rust backend), not Electron. Starts fast, uses minimal RAM, and feels like a Windows app because it is one.
